requirements.general_text: You must meet the following requirements in order to be considered for entry to the UNITAR Bachelor’s Programme: Pass Sijil Tinggi Persekolahan Malaysia (STPM) with at least Grade C+ (CGPA 2.33) in any two (2) subjects; and credit Mathematics and pass in English in SPM; OR Pass Sijil Tinggi Agama Malaysia (STAM) with a minimum Grade of Jayyid and credit Mathematics and pass in English in SPM; OR Pass Diploma in Finance, Diploma in Banking, Diploma in Insurance or related programme (Level 4, MQF) with minimum CGPA of 2.50; OR Pass Matriculation/Foundation with a minimum CGPA of 2.50 and credit Mathematics pass in English at SPM; OR Pass Businesses and Technology Education Council (BTEC) Level 4 & 5 and pass Sijil Pelajaran Malaysia (SPM) with at least three (3) credits in any subjects (or it’s equivalent); OR Any other equivalent qualifications recognized by the Malaysian Government; Language Requirements International Students  IELTS score of 6.0 OR its equivalent.
